query:
-- First, let's see what teams we have
SELECT id, name, COUNT(*) as count FROM teams GROUP BY name HAVING count > 1;

-- Delete duplicate teams, keeping only the ones with the most players
DELETE t1 FROM teams t1
INNER JOIN teams t2 
WHERE t1.id > t2.id 
AND t1.name = t2.name;

-- Verify teams are now unique
SELECT id, name, city FROM teams ORDER BY name;

-- Count total players
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_players FROM players;

-- Show players by team
SELECT t.name, COUNT(p.id) as player_count 
FROM teams t 
LEFT JOIN players p ON t.id = p.teamId 
GROUP BY t.id, t.name 
ORDER BY t.name;
